blurb: Goldwater Brewing Co. is a family-owned craft brewery with three locations. They brew bold, no-nonsense beer and operate taprooms in South Tempe and East Mesa, Arizona. Guests can visit these taprooms to enjoy a rotating lineup of local craft beers in a friendly, community-focused atmosphere.
